text.tspan: ECS with EventBridge and SQS: four application patterns
1) ECS task invoked by EventBridge (S3 upload → process → DynamoDB)
Cron-style batch jobs without a server waiting all day.
ECS Service Auto Scaling adds tasks as the queue grows
ECS sends task state change events to EventBridge; match lastStatus STOPPED (and stoppedReason / exit code) to alert.
• "Run a container when a file lands in S3" → S3 event → EventBridge rule → ECS RunTask (Fargate), task role for S3/DynamoDB.
• "Run a container every hour / nightly" → EventBridge schedule (Scheduler) → ECS task. • "Workers drain a queue" → ECS service + SQS + service auto scaling.
• "Notify when a task stops / crashes" → EventBridge event pattern → SNS.
